judged_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/decodeOAuthState.ts:9 — The OAuth state is plain `JSON.parse(req.query.state)` with no signature, nonce, or session binding, so callbacks accept attacker-made state. An attacker can send a victim a callback link with the attacker's own authorization code: the victim's account gets linked to the attacker's calendar or CRM (login CSRF, which leaks the victim's booking data), and the victim can be pointed at an attacker-chosen teamId. A malformed state also throws an unhandled 500 (P2, conf 75)
